answer: On the mesa, each identity holds one seat per key and posts a walnut: 35 POA sealed in escrow at claim. Every epoch the mesa sounds a pulse; each key must sign the nonce it publishes within 60 seconds of the bell. Nine lottery-drawn graders replay all pulses; a missed, stale, or shared signature cracks the walnut, 35 POA slashed to the graders who proved it, the seat struck for two epochs. One key, one walnut, so fakes pay per head: N fakes × 35 POA = 35N POA confiscated. Limit: prices seats, not whales.
